label: PROVISIONAL_OBSERVATION_COMPARISON / HINDCAST
quality: actual 0301 CDF + official flag definition: 0 nominal, 1 anomalous, unknown flags explicitly rejected
density_field: density only; density_orbitmean separately preserved, never substituted

coordinates.input: product geodetic, GRS80 per official service; verify one actual point per day
coordinates.A: WGS84 geodetic lat and ellipsoid height as native hypothesis
coordinates.D: A height with B latitude; single-factor diagnostic
coordinates.E: A latitude with B height; single-factor diagnostic

metrics.weights: one equal weight per 30s observation, not independent replicates
metrics.relative_denominator: positive observed instantaneous density; no floor

periods.event: UTC=07; separate left/right, excluded from forecast gain

metrics.primary_mask: same quality-valid samples valid for reference and all 8 branches under both A/B mappings; per-model paired masks reported separately
